changelog: v1.1.0: mandatory feed navigation before every profile (anti-detection), pre-flight checklist (data file + browser setup confirmation), fixed tier order (Direct URL → Google → LinkedIn search), raised session cap to 20-25 requests, both Chrome Relay and openclaw isolated browser supported.
summary: Send LinkedIn connection requests to a list of people via browser automation and track status in a CSV/TSV file. Use when the user wants to bulk-connect with a list of people on LinkedIn (founders, speakers, leads, etc.) from a spreadsheet or list containing LinkedIn profile URLs. Handles Connect button, Follow-mode profiles, already-connected detection, stale URL fallback via LinkedIn search and Google search, and incremental status tracking.
